reasons.claim: 2.58 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).
No species records of any kind lie inside the polygon or within 250 m, so there are no eligible species within 250 m.

Three eligible site-bound lichens are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Caloplaca demissa (VU, 687 m, 2019, 25 m uncertainty), Dirina fallax (EN, 977 m, 2021, 181 m uncertainty) and Ramalina obtusata (VU, 977 m, 2021, 181 m uncertainty). All are forest-associated, and their threats include lack of continuity forest. This meets the rubric's MEDIUM rule.

Effort is adequate: 431 records within 1000 m against a county median of 149 (96th percentile). Near-site effort is nonetheless zero records inside the polygon and within 250 m, so there is no site-level survey information.

uncertainties: The two lichens at 977 m sit at the edge of the 1000 m ring and have 181 m uncertainty. Caloplaca demissa (687 m) is the closest eligible record, from 2019.
Landscape-level effort is high but nothing has been recorded within 250 m, so the lack of near-site records may reflect little recording on the site itself.
53 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty at the 1000 m ring.
not_established: That any threatened species occupies the polygon or its immediate surroundings.
That the stand has habitat similar to where the lichens were recorded.
No near-site records does not show absence of species.
next_action: Have a reviewer compare the stand with the lichen record locations 690-980 m away, using the GBIF records, and decide whether a field visit is warranted before felling starts.
